failure_tree_conditions.condition: Demonstrate the Xe -> mixed -> air transition into the delivered feed state without extinction under a defined control schedule.
Show the feed chain reaches the operating pressure after start/eclipse within the allowed time.
Show the ECR stage reaches the ion flux the Hall stage needs, below cutoff or by a demonstrated overdense route.
Show by field analysis (then test) that the ECR resonance and the Hall B(z) coexist at every scheduled setpoint.
Identify a microwave power chain whose efficiency closes the bus ledger and whose life covers the firing and mission hours.
Show a measured erosion rate on the delivered composition that, by the thermal/life extrapolation rule, leaves wall margin at 15,000 h.
Show an anode material whose oxidation on the delivered composition does not change the discharge over the firing life.
Show ECR antenna/window condition and coupling stable over a representative firing on the delivered composition.

Demonstrate Hall-stage start on the delivered atmospheric feed state, or a Xe-assisted start whose Xe per start the air_xe rules allow and whose start Xe over the mission fits the Xe loaded for starts.
Demonstrate ECR-source breakdown on the atmospheric feed at delivered pressure.
Demonstrate that the pre-ionizer lowers (or at least does not raise) the Hall-stage start requirement at the delivered feed state.
Show ECR-to-Hall interstage transmission at or above the break-even requirement.
Close the mass ledger below 40 kg including the Xe inventory.
Demonstrate 12 mN on the delivered composition at a discharge power within what the common bus boundary leaves.
Demonstrate sustained, bounded-oscillation Hall-stage operation on the delivered atmospheric composition without continuous Xe.
Show that the delivered-flow envelope lies inside the demonstrated sustained flow range, or that flow control keeps it there.
Demonstrate the design acceleration voltage and current with the pre-ionizer on, without runaway acceleration-stage current.
Show magnet/coil temperatures below their limits at the worst-case air and Xe setpoints.
Show ECR magnet and resonator temperatures below limits at the design microwave power.
Show channel-wall and anode temperatures below their material limits at the worst-case air and Xe setpoints.
Demonstrate that the ECR stage raises thrust at the common bus power over the hall_only arm on air.

conditions: On the bus-power criterion (necessary, not sufficient), ecr_hall can be named baseline under milestone A only if all of the following are demonstrated: (A) an end-to-end bus cost per delivered ampere C_del,bus <= Pi_H (g_case(X) - omega_f/X) on an air-representative N2/O2/O feed at the common feed state; (B) an interstage transport efficiency eta_t >= Z = C_src,bus / Y on the same charge-current basis; (C) a relative utilization gain X with X_lo(Y, omega_f) <= X <= min(X_hi, (1 - eta_u0)/eta_u0); (D) mass and life break-even (breakeven_v1 Secs. 7-8). (A)-(C) are evaluated at a Hall reference and a response case that milestone A leaves as stated conditions (inside the PROPOSED box, per case); pinning them to an admitted closure and a measured alpha, chi, eta_v,S is the milestone-B step. This overlay does not name a baseline.

Ignition and sustainment on atmospheric propellant

failure_tree_conditions.condition: Demonstrate the Xe -> mixed -> air transition into the delivered feed state without extinction under a defined control schedule.
Show the feed chain reaches the operating pressure after start/eclipse within the allowed time.
Show a measured erosion rate on the delivered composition that, by the thermal/life extrapolation rule, leaves wall margin at 15,000 h.
Show an anode material whose oxidation on the delivered composition does not change the discharge over the firing life.
Show RF window condition and coupling stable over a representative firing on the delivered composition.

Demonstrate Hall-stage start on the delivered atmospheric feed state, or a Xe-assisted start whose Xe per start the air_xe rules allow and whose start Xe over the mission fits the Xe loaded for starts.
Demonstrate RF-source breakdown on the atmospheric feed at delivered pressure, or an allowed noble-gas start.
Demonstrate that the pre-ionizer lowers (or at least does not raise) the Hall-stage start requirement at the delivered feed state.
Show RF-to-Hall interstage transmission at or above the break-even requirement.
Close the mass ledger below 40 kg including the Xe inventory.
Demonstrate 12 mN on the delivered composition at a discharge power within what the common bus boundary leaves.
Demonstrate RF-stage operation above its mode down-transition over the delivered composition envelope with margin.
Demonstrate matched RF operation (bounded reflected power) through ignition and the Xe -> air transition.
Demonstrate regulated Hall and cathode supplies with the RF stage on.
Demonstrate sustained, bounded-oscillation Hall-stage operation on the delivered atmospheric composition without continuous Xe.
Show that the delivered-flow envelope lies inside the demonstrated sustained flow range, or that flow control keeps it there.
Demonstrate the design acceleration voltage and current with the pre-ionizer on, without runaway acceleration-stage current.
Show magnet/coil temperatures below their limits at the worst-case air and Xe setpoints.
Show RF coil, coupler and tube temperatures below limits at the design RF power.
Show channel-wall and anode temperatures below their material limits at the worst-case air and Xe setpoints.
Demonstrate that the RF stage raises thrust at the common bus power over the hall_only arm at the same feed state.
